LR_grant_estates_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_friendly
	icon = icon_gold
	desc = LR_grant_estates_interaction_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			is_landed = no
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:recipient = {
			LR_can_hold_estates_trigger = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = LR_estates_already_major_tt
				LR_estates_can_grow_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 50
	}

	auto_accept = yes

	on_accept = {
		scope:recipient = {
			LR_estates_grow_effect = yes
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = LR_granted_estates_opinion
				opinion = 20
			}
		}
	}

	ai_targets = {
		ai_recipients = courtiers
	}
	ai_frequency = 60
	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
		modifier = { add = 20 scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor } }
		modifier = { add = 10 scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor } }
		modifier = { add = 10 has_trait = generous }
		modifier = { factor = 0 has_trait = greedy }
		modifier = { factor = 0 gold < 200 }  # AI keeps a reserve
	}
}

LR_seize_estates_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_hostile
	icon = icon_gold
	desc = LR_seize_estates_interaction_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			LR_has_estates_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	auto_accept = yes

	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = scope:recipient.LR_estates_sale_value
			add_tyranny = 5
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = LR_seized_estates_opinion
				opinion = -30
			}
			LR_estates_clear_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_frequency = 0
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}

	category = interaction_category_friendly
	icon = house_head_request_interaction
	desc = LR_raise_noble_house_interaction_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = {

			government_allows = noble_families

		scope:recipient = {
			is_courtier_of = scope:actor

		scope:recipient = {

			exists = house

		}

	cost = {
		prestige = 200

			custom_tooltip = LR_raise_noble_house_estates_tt

			create_noble_family_effect = { GOVERNMENT_GIVER = scope:actor }
			domicile ?= { set_up_domicile_estate_effect = yes }
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = LR_granted_estates_opinion
				opinion = 30
			}
		}
	}

	ai_targets = {
		ai_recipients = courtiers

	ai_frequency = 120
	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
		modifier = { add = 20 scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor } }
		modifier = { add = 10 scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor } }
		modifier = { factor = 0 prestige < 500 }  # AI keeps a reserve
